_meta.description: Layer1: euglossine (orchid) bee x plant visitation/pollination (GloBI visitsFlowersOf/pollinates, restricted to Euglossa/Eulaema/Eufriesea/Exaerete/Aglae) plus curated Choco/NW-Andes orchid fragrance-pollination records from the euglossine literature. Layer2: additional Ithomiini larval host-plant records (GloBI hasHost/eats, restricted to documented host families Solanaceae/Apocynaceae/Gesneriaceae and to Nymphalidae source taxa), deduped against the existing curated interactions_ithomiini.json. Most euglossine associations are fragrance/bait-based -> certainty 'regional candidate', needs_field_verification true; bees confirmed from Ecuador are noted via GBIF.
sources: Padron et al. 2018 Psyche 2018:2678632 (Ecuador orchid bee checklist; species-occurrence scoping)
GBIF occurrence facets (Ecuador euglossine species confirmation)
Roubik & Hanson 2004 Orchid Bees of Tropical America; Dressler 1968/1982; Ramirez et al. 2002 (euglossine-orchid pollination)
